verdict.rationale: The README's install section lists a Winget entry, which implies a standard package-manager install path on Windows. Docker images, pre-built release binaries and llama.app instructions are offered as further quick-install alternatives. The package-manager evidence, however, is only a bare heading with no commands or details. Missing for 10: documented package-manager install commands, package managers for macOS/Linux (only Winget is evidenced), and independent hands-on confirmation of a package-manager install.
